# foundby

> Ask your coding agent how people find your site. foundby is a free, open-source skill for Claude Code and other coding agents, plus a few Python scripts. It keeps a ledger in your repo of every distinct way a person has ever reached your site (referring hosts, AI assistants, link-preview platforms, in-app browsers, Google Analytics sources, backlinks and web mentions) and each run reports only what is new since the last one. The agent looks up each new host and records what it is.

The prompt to give an agent: "Set up foundby.dev in this repo and tell me how people are finding this site."

## Links

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/preziotte/foundby): source, SKILL.md, install instructions (MIT)
- [Sources](https://github.com/preziotte/foundby/blob/main/docs/sources.md): what each data source sees, what it costs, how to wire it
- [agenttraffic](https://agenttraffic.io): the sibling tool that reads the same CDN logs and reports what AI agents did on a site

## Key facts

- Install: clone the repo into `.claude/skills/foundby` (per project) or symlink it into `~/.claude/skills/foundby` (every project). Python 3.10+.
- Config is one `foundby.json` in the site's repo: site, aliases, own hosts, ledger path, optional Google Analytics 4, CloudFront edge logs and Bing Webmaster blocks.
- Sources: mention search (Hacker News, GitHub code search, Bluesky, Lobsters, YouTube video descriptions, Reddit with a manual step), GA4 (utm and gclid sources, AI Assistant channel, in-app browsers, referring pages via custom dimensions), CloudFront logs (link previews, AI assistants fetching pages, referrers without JavaScript), Bing backlinks. Every source is optional and degrades alone; a bare domain still gets the mention search.
- `foundby.py doctor` checks which sources are wired and says what each missing one would add; with GA4 connected it also reads 90 days of channel mix to recommend.
- State is two files in the user's repo (`docs/foundby.md` and `.json`). No hosted service, no account, no telemetry. Client IPs are never read from logs.
- Hits are a magnitude (edge hits plus GA sessions overlap), never presented as sessions or visitors.
- Commands: `/foundby setup`, `/foundby`, `/foundby open` in Claude Code; `foundby.py init|doctor|run|set|mention|render|view` from a shell.
